title: Soft tissue injury or abnormality under continuing surgical management
summary: Soft tissue injury (including burns) under continuing surgical management directed at saving, reconstructing, or replacing the affected part, with continuing management expected to last ≥12 months and maximum benefit from therapy not yet achieved.

children.criterion: Soft tissue injury or abnormality of an extremity, trunk, or face/head requiring continuing surgical management
Continuing surgical management directed at saving, reconstructing, or replacing the affected body part
Continuing surgical management expected to last, or has lasted, ≥12 months from initial event, with maximum benefit from therapy not yet achieved
